title: Fungal Hyphae as Distributed Vapor Sinks
description: Analysis code, processed data, and raw microscopy data for: Fungal Hyphae as Distributed Vapor Sinks (Lin, Feng, Khan, Park & Jung). Contents: 35 per-trial zip archives with raw microscopy images (JPG), Cellpose segmentation masks (NPY), and calibration metadata (JSON) for hydrogel calibration (20 trials: 5 agar, 5 NaCl 0.5:1, 5 NaCl 1:1, 5 NaCl 2:1) and fungal colony experiments (15 trials: 5 Aspergillus, 5 Mucor, 5 Rhizopus); colony morphology images for Figure 4 (3D Aspergillus + Mucor brightfield ROIs and light-microscopy images); field validation imagery on Gymnosporangium-infected Malus leaves (6 trials: 3 healthy, 3 diseased with secondary saprophytic colonization); chamber stability traces across 13 trials; the complete analysis code repository (fungal-condensation-code.zip) including figure-generation scripts; and the supplementary movies referenced in the manuscript. Processed CSVs sufficient to reproduce all figures are included in the code archive. Note: internal directory names in trial zips may differ from the zip filename due to lab naming conventions; the calibration.json in each zip matches the analysis pipeline.
notes: Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19391416 resolves to the latest version. The companion code repository is also mirrored at https://github.com/Yany-Lin/fungal-condensation. Raw microscopy images and Cellpose segmentation masks are provided as per-trial zip archives; processed CSVs sufficient to reproduce all figures are also included via the code archive.
